report.summary: Payments-api p99 latency spiked starting at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00 due to a synchronous dependency on ledger-service, which experienced immediate p99 latency degradation starting at 13:19:00+00:00. This upstream latency spike was directly triggered by the rollout of the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag from 10% to 100% at 13:18:00+00:00.

ranked_hypotheses.title: Ledger Service Feature Flag Rollout Contention

supporting.note: Feature flag change occurred at 13:18 UTC, precisely 2 minutes before the payments-api latency spike onset.
ledger-service p99 latency spiked starting at 13:19:00+00:00, immediately following the rollout.
payments-api p99 latency spiked sharply upward starting exactly at 13:20:00+00:00.
Establishes the synchronous dependency path from payments-api to ledger-service.

contradicting.note: Error rate increased slightly later at 13:25 UTC rather than simultaneously with the 13:20 latency spike.

supporting.note: Shows warnings and retries calling upi-gateway prior to the incident.
Shows slow request intent logs on payments-api shortly before the onset.

contradicting.note: The observed retries and slow requests occurred at 12:53 and 13:00, which are significantly earlier than the 13:20 onset.
The latency anomaly aligns precisely with ledger-service feature rollout rather than any new upi-gateway signal at 13:20.

facts.text: payments-api p99 latency spiked starting at 2026-10-11T13:20:00+00:00, jumping from a baseline of ~380ms to 3239.85ms.
payments-api error rate increased starting at 2026-10-11T13:25:00+00:00, going from ~0.3% to ~1.2%.
TLS deprecation warnings for 'legacy-psp' have been logged continuously since 12:00:00+00:00, predating the latency spike.
payments-api directly depends on ledger-service, upi-gateway, fraud-service, redis-cache, and event-bus, and is called by mobile-bff.
A feature flag rollout chg-9802 for ledger.reconciliation_v2 from 10% to 100% occurred on ledger-service at 2026-10-11T13:18:00+00:00.
Ledger-service latency_p99_ms experienced an anomaly starting at 2026-10-11T13:19:00+00:00, peaking at 3364.94 ms at 13:23:00+00:00.

assumptions: ledger-service experienced internal computational or query overhead under 100% reconciliation_v2 traffic that propagated back to payments-api.

timeline.event: TLS deprecation warnings for legacy-psp start logging continuously on payments-api
Feature flag ledger.reconciliation_v2 rolled out from 10% to 100% on ledger-service (chg-9802)
payments-api p99 latency anomaly begins (incident onset)
payments-api error rate begins to increase

recommended_actions.action: Roll back the ledger.reconciliation_v2 feature flag on ledger-service to the previous 10% state.
recommended_actions.rationale: Directly mitigates the latency introduced by the 100% reconciliation rollout.

recommended_actions.action: Investigate ledger-service reconciliation query performance and resource usage under full load.
recommended_actions.rationale: Identifies why the 100% feature flag rollout caused p99 latency to spike on ledger-service.

recommended_actions.action: Implement circuit breakers or asynchronous handling between payments-api and synchronous dependencies like ledger-service to prevent cascading latency spikes.
recommended_actions.rationale: Protects payments-api from downstream performance degradation.
